configurations.// hub-fixtures: Runs the Hub with VITE_FIXTURES=1. With no Firebase env (no .env.local) db is null, so AuthGate signs in as a 'Fixture Director' and the director panel opens with no credentials and no real data — see src/director/hooks/fixtures.ts. Read-only: writes are no-ops.
configurations.// port: vite does not read $PORT, so it must be passed through, or vite silently sits on 5173 while the harness reports the port it assigned. strictPort makes a clash fail loudly instead of drifting again.
